responsibility: Provides the shared infrastructure used by all BIR builders while lowering Rust HIR to borrow-checker IR. It defines BuilderContext for accumulated basic blocks, PlaceDB state, scopes, loop/label context, function free regions, and type/resolver access, and it implements the AbstractBuilder and AbstractExprBuilder helper APIs for variable declaration, scope lifetime markers, temporary creation, path lookup, assignments, coercions, autoderef/autoref, region binding, and expression-result handling that the specialized builder classes build on.
